title: Facade – Sliding Doors (PER Schüco)
activity: Schüco sliding doors: threshold, frame, vents, glazing, hardware, sealing, sensors and interfaces
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

location.areaHint: e.g. W49, south elevation, grid C4

questions.q: Precast around the opening complete, brackets fixed per the door installation drawing?
questions.source: PER ITP 31-0001 – door installation checklist 3.3; PER ITP 31-0001 – PUK-QC-03-SLD sliding inspection 2.2

questions.q: Threshold regulated, level and fixed solid (no rocking)?
Bottom steel tube in and the Obex membrane lapped up behind it (W49/W54 type)?
Compriband Illmod TP 600 in place around the opening?
Door pack checked – no damage to frames, vents or glass before installing?
Ask the fitter: How is the threshold sealed into the membrane, and what's the drainage route? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Frame level and plumb, diagonals equal (within 1 mm)?
Corner joints: sealant/glue visible at the screw pin holes, profiles flush at corners?
Fixed vent clean and undamaged, end caps sealed?
External gasket in place and glued at the corners (no gaps or shrink-back)?
Sliding vent and fixed vent aligned at the central meeting point?
Glass undamaged and clean; kite mark (P4A) bottom-left viewed from inside?
questions.source: PER ITP 31-0001 – PUK-QC-03-SLD sliding inspection 6.1–6.2; PER ITP 31-0001 – final post-installation check 2.4

questions.q: Glazing beads all fitted and secure?
Anti-lift-out device fitted?
Brush seal refitted and condensation collector caps fixed and sealed?
Drainage slots in the track clear (no debris, silicone or mortar)?
questions.source: Site good practice – not an ITP line (confirm with PER)

questions.q: Slides smoothly full travel, no binding, closes fully onto the seals?
questions.source: PER ITP 31-0001 – PUK-QC-03-SLD sliding inspection 6.7; PER ITP 31-0001 – final post-installation check 2.9

questions.q: Locks, handle and keys all working; door locks securely (RC2)?
questions.source: PER ITP 31-0001 – door installation checklist – locks and keys functioning

questions.q: Door alarm sensor fitted and tested working – door relocked after the test?
questions.source: PER ITP 31-0001 – PUK-QC-03-SLD sliding inspection 6.11; PER ITP 31-0001 – final post-installation check 2.8

questions.q: Sensor/automation conduit in, terminated and accessible for the follow-on trade?
Door contact installed and connected to the security system (LMG)?
questions.source: LMG security ITP – access control device checklist items 5, 10

questions.q: External perimeter seal continuous and tooled (SikaHyflex 250), no gaps at the threshold corners?
Internal seal around the frame (Kommerling GD116) complete?
Sill membrane and pressings in, sealed at the ends?
questions.source: PER ITP 31-0001 – perimeter seals, sill membrane & sill

questions.q: No scratches or marks on the frame or glass?
Protection on, door locked to stop unauthorised use?
Automatic sliding / powered door: opens and closes smoothly, stops and reverses when obstructed?
questions.source: PER tech subs SJWS-PER-ZZ-ZZ-TS-X-31-7070 (Schüco automatic sliding electrical units) & 31-7068 (GEZE Powerturn)

questions.q: Drive unit cover fitted, cabling hidden and terminated, isolator labelled and accessible?
Access control / door entry proved: reader opens, release works, fire alarm releases the hold-open?
questions.source: PER 31-7069 steel door electrical components; LMG ACS checklist

notOk.t: Handles, escutcheons and lock covers missing or wrong colour
Scratches and chips to frames (re-spray needed)
Sliding frame bent or dented in the bottom track
Threshold cover not installed / gaps at side flashings with shims visible
